## 2. Job Description

Quillon Systems builds warehouse control software for mid-sized retailers. For a 12-month contract we need a Project
Coordinator who keeps our customer rollouts on track.

Your tasks:
- Plan customer rollouts with the implementation engineers and the customer's operations team.
- Keep the project plan, budget and risk log up to date and report status every week.
- Run the kickoff, the go-live checklist and the handover to support.

Your profile:
- 3+ years coordinating projects with several teams, ideally in logistics or retail.
- Good with Excel and a ticket tool such as Jira.
- Fluent English and German.

Hybrid work in Berlin; monthly gross pay of EUR 5,000 to 5,600.
